# notation usage interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:notationUsageInterval`](gmeow-notationUsageInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationUsageInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which the notation usage is asserted to hold. Functional per relator: one interval per [`NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:notationUsageInterval`](gmeow-notationUsageInterval.md) from [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md), [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) relator to scope the single period over which the notation usage is asserted to hold — the temporal frame of this observation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one interval per relator (it is functional — a changed period is a new usage) and avoid putting raw dates here; point at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:notationUsageInterval`](gmeow-notationUsageInterval.md) on each usage relator, pointing at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md), alongside the target, notation-system, and role roles.
